name: Inverse Rendering of Translucent Objects
definition: An inverse rendering framework that estimates 3D shape, spatially-varying reflectance, homogeneous subsurface scattering (SSS) parameters, and environment illumination jointly from only a pair of captured images (flash and no-flash) of a translucent object.
summary: Inverse Rendering of Translucent Objects jointly estimates 3D shape, surface reflectance, and homogeneous subsurface scattering from two images, distinguishing glossy translucent materials from transparent ones.
